quality_bound.scope: fixed final states, conditional on training; simultaneous ideal-sampling union bound over every final group

diagnostic.hamiltonian: -sum_i Z_i+0.5 sum_i X_i X_(i+1); open chain
diagnostic.method: independent Pauli-tensor Hamiltonian/eigvalsh and RY-product/CNOT-permutation state
diagnostic.timing_scope: bounded classical reference CPU wall time; no hardware preparation or feedback
diagnostic.accuracy_scope: numerical dense/scalar reference; no formal quantum/optimizer guarantee

timing_scope: local CPU sampling, controller, heldout validation and independent classical audits; not quantum hardware time
quality_selection: all predetermined inputs/seeds including misses; no best-seed or best-size selection
limitations: small deterministic ideal CPU study; no hardware noise or advantage claim
descriptive fixed-budget polling margin, not a convergence theorem
post-training exact diagnostics do not drive optimizer decisions
simultaneous holdout coverage excludes adaptive training queries
VQE restricted ansatz may not contain the ground state; no global ansatz optimum certified
physical initialization/reset, routing and feedback timing unmeasured
conditional synthesis and fault models require a separate complete recorded-workload report
existing Lean proof covers classical C4 only, not these families or quantum dynamics

device.backend: CPU Qiskit Statevector and NumPy PCG64 ideal group sampling; dense classical references

provenance.revision_note: source_commit identifies the checkout base at generation; content hashes identify the implementation and generator actually executed

representative_circuits.selection: first predetermined case and seed, not best outcome

artifact_timing_scope: includes trace reconstruction, export and plotting; separate from CPU study/controller timings
